chunks.subject: AP Physics 2
chunks.title: Q1 Mathematical Routines (MR) — 10 points
chunks.content: AP Physics 2 FRQ 1 is Mathematical Routines (MR), 10 points, scored by lettered sub-points (A1, A2, …). The MR task requires multi-step derivations/calculations with correct physics relationships, substitutions, and expressions consistent across parts. Q1 topic: magnetism and current (magnetic force/field on a current-carrying element). Points reward writing the correct governing relationship, correct substitutions, and final expressions consistent with earlier parts. Common failure: omitting the intermediate relationship; sign/direction errors in the magnetic force; expressions inconsistent with prior parts.
